parameters.name: AccessModes
parameters.description:
The access mode. Valid values:
- **app**: application access. Filters applications that support application access.
- **browser**: browser access. Filters applications that support browser access.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The address of the internal-facing access application. The address is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports IPv4 addresses, CIDR blocks, domain names, and wildcard domain names.

parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: The IDs of internal-facing access applications. You can specify up to 100 application IDs.

parameters.name: ConnectorId
parameters.description: The connector ID. You can obtain the ID from the [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) operation.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page displayed in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the internal-facing access application. The name is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the internal-facing access policy. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): queries internal-facing access policies in batches.
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): creates an internal-facing access policy.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

parameters.name: TagId
parameters.description:
The ID of the internal-facing access tag. You can obtain the ID from the following operations:
- [ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): queries internal-facing access tags in batches.
- [CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): creates an internal-facing access tag.
